page_title: RSO 1-0 MAL | Real Sociedad v Mallorca 24/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Iosu Galech has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
90+1' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
86' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Iosu Galech had an easy-decision to make.
85' Sergio Francisco has decided to substitute Ander Barrenetxea and he is replaced by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
85' Here's the change. Takefusa Kubo leaves the pitch and Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
84' The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
83' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Mallorca! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Iosu Galech and both teams have no complaints.
82' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Mallorca as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
81' The players claim that Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. The referee points to the penalty spot. Mallorca are awarded a penalty kick!
80' Mallorca will take a corner kick.
79' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) replacing Pablo Maffeo.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toni Lato departs the field of play to be replaced by Johan Mojica (Mallorca).
79' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
78' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
75' Sergio Francisco has decided to make a change. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) replaces Brais Mendez.
74' It is time for a substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is on for Sergio Gomez.
70' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
70' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
69' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
67' The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
65' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
64' It will be a substitution. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is ready to enter the pitch as Carlos Soler walks off.
63' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanchez will be replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
62' A substitution has been made. David Lopez is replaced by Marc Domenech (Mallorca).
61' 9:0 – the corner kicks stats.
60' Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
56' The ball is cleared after Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
54' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
53' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) scores after an assist by Ander Barrenetxea that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.

47' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
46' Referee Iosu Galech blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Sociedad.
44' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is being substituted because of an injury. Jagoba Arrasate sends Samu Costa on the pitch.
43' Iosu Galech blows the whistle, Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul.
42' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

39' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
38' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down. Iosu Galech has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
35' The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
34' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
34' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
34' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
32' David Lopez (Mallorca) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
28' The current number of corner kicks is 5:0.

25' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Alex Remiro anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
23' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
20' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad), whose header goes wide of the goal.
19' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.

19' Great save! Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Leo Roman. Real Sociedad force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Iosu Galech has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
17' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
13' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
12' Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
10' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
6' Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
6' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Real Sociedad! Play can continue.
6' Referee Iosu Galech makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Real Sociedad. Let’s see what happens!
5' Surely that's handball by one of the Mallorca players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
4' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
4' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
1' The first half has started.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Iosu Galech will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
